meta.title: 欧洲vlog第一篇｜一年一度再见巴黎🌡️
meta.title_en: Europe Vlog #1 | Seeing Paris Again, Once a Year

scenes.title_en: Fitting Session: Prepping for Fashion Week
scenes.context: 博主来到巴黎参加时装周，先给妈妈爸爸鼓掌，因为收拾行李要崩溃了。fitting从下午两点开始，差不多四个小时弄完衣服。语域：日常口播，轻松吐槽。
sentences: 又到了一年一度的时装周期间，我一年一度的欧洲之行啦。
It's that time of year again — fashion week, and my annual trip to Europe.
fashion week（时装周）；annual trip（一年一度的旅行）
我本来想给大家room tour一下，但是有点乱现在。
I was going to give you a room tour, but it's a bit of a mess right now.
room tour（房间参观）；a bit of a mess（有点乱）
差不多四个小时弄完衣服，中间休息了半个小时吧。
It took about four hours to sort out the outfits, with a half-hour break in between.
sort out the outfits（整理衣服）；with a break in between（中间休息）
paraphrase: 一年一度 → annual / once a year / that time of year again
annual · once a year
有点乱 → a bit of a mess / a little chaotic
a mess · chaotic
scenes.speak: It's that time of year again — fashion week, and my annual trip to Europe. I was going to give you a room tour, but it's a bit of a mess right now. It took about four hours to sort out the outfits, with a half-hour break in between.

scenes.title_cn: 化妆间：从剧组带回的东西
scenes.title_en: The Makeup Room: Stuff from the Film Set
scenes.context: 来到化妆间，地上的东西都是从剧组带回来的还没整理：各种发棒、磨脚贴，甚至还有给皮带打孔的机器。语域：日常口播，带点惊叹。
sentences: 来到了我的化妆间，地上的这些都是从剧组带回来的。
This is my makeup room — everything on the floor was brought back from the film set.
makeup room（化妆间）；the film set（剧组）
还有一些发棒呢、磨脚贴啊，各种琐碎的东西。
There are curling wands, blister pads, all sorts of little odds and ends.
curling wands（卷发棒）；blister pads（磨脚贴）；odds and ends（琐碎物品）
甚至那个皮带上打孔的机器我们都会带。
We even bring the machine used to punch holes in belts.
punch holes（打孔）；we even bring（连…都带）
paraphrase: 琐碎的东西 → odds and ends / bits and bobs / little things
odds and ends · bits and bobs
从剧组带回 → brought back from the film set / hauled home from set
brought back · hauled home
scenes.speak: This is my makeup room — everything on the floor was brought back from the film set. There are curling wands, blister pads, all sorts of little odds and ends. We even bring the machine used to punch holes in belts.

scenes.title_en: A Three-Story Guesthouse: The Air Is Great
scenes.context: 入住新民宿，一共三层，厨房漂亮，房间很大，没有空调只有风扇但也没那么热。博主感叹空气特别好，拍照肯定很好看。语域：日常口播，入住体验。
sentences: 哇，这个跟上总舟的螺很像，空气特别好。
Wow, this place feels like home — the air is especially fresh.
the air is fresh（空气好）；feel like home（有家的感觉）
一共三层，哇这房间好漂亮哦。
There are three floors in total — wow, this room is gorgeous.
three floors in total（一共三层）；gorgeous（很漂亮）
没有空调就个风扇，但也并没有那么热。
No air conditioning, just a fan, but it's not even that hot.
no AC, just a fan（没有空调只有风扇）；not that hot（没那么热）
paraphrase: 空气特别好 → the air is especially fresh / the air is so clean
air is fresh · so clean
很漂亮 → gorgeous / stunning / lovely
gorgeous · stunning · lovely
scenes.speak: Wow, this place feels like home — the air is especially fresh. There are three floors in total — wow, this room is gorgeous. No air conditioning, just a fan, but it's not even that hot.

scenes.title_en: Paris Streets: A Leisurely Shopping Day
scenes.context: 今天是休闲逛街日，天气很好。博主的朋友从湖南来，一起去吃泰国菜，点了猪颈肉和猪油渣，非常辣的小米辣很正宗。语域：日常对话，吃货氛围。
sentences: 今天是休闲的一天，天气真的很好。
Today is a relaxing day — the weather is really nice.
a relaxing day（休闲的一天）；the weather is nice（天气很好）
这个是超辣的，我说这个猪颈肉我不知道怎么说。
This one is extra spicy — I don't even know how to describe this pork neck.
extra spicy（超辣）；pork neck（猪颈肉）
这个绝对正宗小米辣，我跟你讲这个好辣。
These are absolutely authentic bird's-eye chilies — I'm telling you, these are hot.
authentic（正宗）；bird's-eye chilies（小米辣）
paraphrase: 休闲的一天 → a relaxing day / a chill day / a laid-back day
relaxing · chill · laid-back
正宗 → authentic / the real deal
authentic · the real deal
scenes.speak: Today is a relaxing day — the weather is really nice. This one is extra spicy — I don't even know how to describe this pork neck. These are absolutely authentic bird's-eye chilies — I'm telling you, these are hot.

scenes.title_cn: 和发小豪哥聊妈妈们的闺蜜往事
scenes.title_en: Childhood Friend Hao: Moms' Sisterhood Story
scenes.context: 和发小豪哥吃饭时聊起两家妈妈的闺蜜情：三位闺蜜同一年各生了一个宝宝，三人从幼儿园、小学、高中都在同班，后来各奔城市又重逢。语域：闲聊对话，温情回忆。
sentences: 我妈和他妈从初中开始就是闺蜜。
My mom and his mom have been best friends since middle school.
be best friends（闺蜜）；since middle school（从初中起）
三个闺蜜，同时在那一年生了三个宝宝。
The three best friends each had a baby in the same year.
each had a baby（各生了一个宝宝）；in the same year（同一年）
我们从幼儿园、小学、高中都在同一个班。
We were in the same class all the way from kindergarten through high school.
in the same class（同班）；from ... through ...（从…一直到…）
paraphrase: 从初中起就是闺蜜 → best friends since middle school / been close since middle school
best friends · since middle school
从小到大同班 → same class from kindergarten through high school / schoolmates our whole childhood
same class · schoolmates
scenes.speak: My mom and his mom have been best friends since middle school. The three best friends each had a baby in the same year. We were in the same class all the way from kindergarten through high school.

scenes.title_cn: 巴黎时间8点22：铁塔晒太阳
scenes.title_en: 8:22 in Paris: Soaking Up the Sun at the Tower
scenes.context: 一行六人坐观光船在塞纳河上，来到埃菲尔铁塔前晒太阳。现在是巴黎时间8点22分，大家拍照、开怀大笑。语域：旅行现场，兴奋活泼。
sentences: 哇，刚好装下我们六个人。
Wow, it fits all six of us perfectly.
fit ... people（装下…人）；perfectly（正好）
我们来到铁塔这晒太阳了，现在是巴黎时间8点22分。
We've come to sunbathe by the Eiffel Tower — it's 8:22 in Paris right now.
sunbathe（晒太阳）；it's 8:22 in Paris（巴黎时间8点22）
哇这个船怎么那么大啊。
Wow, why is this boat so huge?
huge（巨大）；口语感叹：why is ... so ...
paraphrase: 晒太阳 → sunbathe / soak up the sun / catch some rays
sunbathe · soak up the sun
装下六个人 → fits all six of us / room for six
fits us · room for six
scenes.speak: Wow, it fits all six of us perfectly. We've come to sunbathe by the Eiffel Tower — it's 8:22 in Paris right now. Wow, why is this boat so huge?

scenes.title_en: Photographing in Front of the Tower
scenes.context: 在铁塔前拍照，大家互相指导跳跃姿势，喊着321按快门。博主调侃别把大家带到铁塔里去。语域：现场拍摄，热闹互动。
sentences: 好，321，你要跳高一点。
Okay, three, two, one — you need to jump higher.
jump higher（跳高一点）；countdown（倒计时）
我手没跟上，再来再来，深一点321。
My hands weren't quick enough — again, again, deeper, three two one.
quick enough（跟得上）；再来再来（again, again）
哪有人在飞铁塔，我好怕把你带到铁塔去。
Who even takes a flying jump in front of the Eiffel Tower? I'm afraid we'll take you right into the tower.
flying jump（飞跃动作）；take you into（把你带到）
paraphrase: 跳高一点 → jump higher / give it more height
jump higher · more height
再来一次 → again / one more time / take two
again · one more time · take two
scenes.speak: Okay, three, two, one — you need to jump higher. My hands weren't quick enough — again, again, deeper, three two one. Who even takes a flying jump in front of the Eiffel Tower? I'm afraid we'll take you right into the tower.

scenes.title_en: The Place Where Cilantro Tastes Amazing
scenes.context: 晚上换了一家店吃饭，这家香菜超级好吃，大家赞不绝口。博主卸完妆洗完澡到酒店，开始护肤时间，拿出可爱的baby玩偶，晚安。语域：日常口播，温馨收尾。
sentences: 哎这个呢，这家的香菜超级好吃。
Oh this — the cilantro at this place is unbelievably good.
cilantro（香菜）；unbelievably good（超级好吃）
我刚刚卸完妆洗完澡，已经到酒店了，现在开始我们的护肤时间。
I've just taken off my makeup and showered — we're back at the hotel, so now it's skincare time.
take off my makeup（卸妆）；skincare time（护肤时间）
我把包包里的这个baby拿出来放在这上面，超级可爱。
I took this little baby doll out of my bag and put it right here — it's adorable.
adorable（超级可爱）；take out of my bag（从包里拿出）
paraphrase: 超级好吃 → unbelievably good / absolutely delicious / to die for
unbelievably good · delicious · to die for
护肤时间 → skincare time / my nightly routine
skincare · nightly routine
scenes.speak: Oh this — the cilantro at this place is unbelievably good. I've just taken off my makeup and showered — we're back at the hotel, so now it's skincare time. I took this little baby doll out of my bag and put it right here — it's adorable.

practice: 跟朋友描述时装周准备有多忙
Fashion week prep is crazy — it took four hours just to sort out the outfits.
The food at this place is unbelievably good — I'll definitely come back.
We've been friends since kindergarten — our moms have been best friends for decades.
We were jumping in front of the Eiffel Tower, counting three, two, one.
pitfalls: The fashion week is once a year.
I take an annual trip to Europe for fashion week.
once a year 形容频率，但『一年一度的旅行』更自然用 annual trip；主语是人。
gorgeous 比 pretty 更强烈，更贴合 Vlog 里看到漂亮房间的惊叹感。
I don't know how to say pork neck.
I don't even know how to describe this pork neck.
describe（描述味道/口感）比 say（怎么说这个词）更贴切语境。
We're in same class since kindergarten.
We were in the same class from kindergarten through high school.
时间跨度用 from A through B；since 只接时间点，不能接一个区间。
shifts: 用 unbelievably good、super tasty、authentic（正宗）、to die for
说一起玩只会 play together
用 hang out（出去玩）、be in the same class、spend time together 表达不同场景
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已校正：高顶洲→时装周、臂带→编带、绝发棒→卷发棒、磨脚贴→磨脚贴、上总舟的螺→故乡的螺、搞音秀→高定秀、小米辣→小米辣、爆筋→鲍菇、空瓶→躺平、外方小花→外防新冠、怕烧→怕烧、接不了吃→吃不了饭等。
